title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Senior Full-Stack Platform Engineer Synaps is building a new standard for architectural design with AI. At the center of the product is a browser-based CAD platform combining precise drafting, real-time collaboration, AI-assisted workflows, and the production systems that make all of this work reliably. We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Platform Engineer who can own a broad part of the Synaps production application outside the CAD editor core. You should be equally comfortable shipping customer-facing full-stack features and designing the backend, data, realtime, storage, authentication, billing, and service infrastructure behind them. This is not a pure backend or infrastructure role. We need someone who can take a product requirement, design the systems behind it, ship it to users, and remain responsible for how it behaves in production. What you’ll work on You’ll own a broad production surface across the Synaps application and the cloud services that support it. Design and operate backend APIs, application services, and data models Own authentication, authorization, permissions, tenancy, billing, and storage across product features Build and operate realtime services supporting collaborative product experiences Ship full-stack product features outside the CAD editor core, including their frontend, APIs, data, permissions, reliability, and observability Design safe contracts between the browser application, backend services, realtime systems, and editor Own backend trust boundaries used by AI, including authentication, team context, service contracts, storage, and usage or credit settlement Design background and event-driven workflows with proper handling of retries, idempotency, failures, and recovery Build systems with security, observability, cost, migrations, and rollback in mind from the beginning Improve reliability and operability across production services as Synaps scales Work closely with Editor Platform on editor and realtime-client contracts Collaborate with AI Engineering on the private AI runtime and service boundaries Work directly with Product Design and product stakeholders to turn product requirements into maintainable systems Partner with the CTO on high-risk architecture, migrations, and rollout decisions You won’t just implement tickets or isolated services. You’ll own meaningful parts of the product from architecture through deployment and production operation. Our stack Our current environment includes: TypeScript React Cloudflare Workers Durable Objects WebSockets Hono tRPC Drizzle Postgres R2 and object storage Authentication and permission systems Realtime and collaborative infrastructure AI service integrations Structured logging, tracing, and observability The exact tools matter less than the fundamentals. Strong candidates coming from AWS, GCP, Azure, Go, Java, Kotlin, or other production stacks are equally interesting if they have owned comparable systems. What you bring Strong experience owning meaningful production systems end to end Strong full-stack or backend engineering experience in TypeScript or a comparable language Experience designing and operating APIs and relational data models Experience with authentication, authorization, permissions, and multi-user application systems Experience with background jobs, event-driven systems, or distributed workflows Experience with object storage and production data lifecycle concerns Experience operating stateful or realtime systems Strong understanding of retries, idempotency, durability, concurrency, failure handling, and recovery Ability to design maintainable service and data contracts from product requirements Strong understanding of security, observability, migrations, operational cost, and rollback strategies Ability to reason about boundaries between frontend, backend, infrastructure, and product behavior Strong communication across engineering, product, and design High ownership and comfort working without a predefined implementation playbook Nice to have Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, R2, Hono, tRPC, or Drizzle Experience with WebSockets, multiplayer products, collaborative applications, or CRDT-backed systems Experience building realtime or synchronization infrastructure Experience with AI gateways, agent runtimes, RAG, model providers, or usage metering Experience with billing and subscription infrastructure Experience building permissions and team-based SaaS products Experience in a small product company where engineers both ship and operate their systems Experience with complex creative tools, editors, CAD, BIM, or other stateful applications How we work We’re a startup. You get real ownership, move fast, and work directly on production systems that determine whether Synaps remains reliable as the product grows. You won’t be responsible only for writing backend endpoints or keeping infrastructure alive. We expect you to understand the product requirement, make the important technical decisions, build the system across the necessary boundaries, and follow it through production. We make ownership explicit. The Full-stack Platform Engineer owns the application and cloud systems around the editor, while specialist teams own areas such as CAD geometry, editor internals, AI behavior, and product design. Good collaboration means building clean contracts between those areas rather than turning everything into a generic platform abstraction. We’re building a small team of sharp, creative builders who want to be early at a generational company. We care deeply about craft, ship world-class products, and expect a high bar. If that resonates with you, this is the place. Perks and benefits Competitive compensation Flexible, trust-based work setup Relocation and visa support Off-sites that aren’t cringe 25 days of paid vacation per year Hiring process Screening call, 30 min, remote Technical problem to solve, 3 to 4 hours, remote or in-person Founders interview(s), 1 hour, remote or in-person Meet the team, 2 hours, remote or in-person

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Highlights: Location: Remote (CET hours preferred) Language: Russian-speaking team About Fundraise Up We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver. A Truly Global Product We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe. We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals , admin tools , and several internal apps. Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB . The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React , with nearly all code written in TypeScript . For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis) . Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse , and we use Elasticsearch for search. The Team We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first. About The Role As a Backend Engineer, you will be a key architect of the engine that powers our global platform. You'll resolve complex challenges in a high-load, distributed system, building and scaling the infrastructure that processes millions in donations. This is not a maintenance role; it's a high-impact, product-focused engineering position where clean architecture, performance, and reliability are paramount. You will work on a complex product ecosystem—from our modern checkout experience to donor portals and massive analytics pipelines—all powered by a cutting-edge tech stack. Backend: Node.js (Koa, NestJS), TypeScript Database: MongoDB Infrastructure: Kafka for event streaming, Bull (Redis) for background jobs, ClickHouse for analytics, and Elasticsearch for search. What You’ll Do Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable backend services in Node.js and TypeScript. Develop new product features from concept to deployment, collaborating closely with product managers and frontend engineers. Own key parts of our backend architecture, making critical decisions that enhance performance, reliability, and security. Write comprehensive unit tests and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality. Proactively identify and implement system improvements, refactoring legacy code where necessary. Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence by mentoring others and sharing your expertise. At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate. Requirements Experience: 7+ years of backend development experience, preferably in a product-driven environment. Node.js Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with Node.js and modern frameworks like Koa or NestJS. TypeScript Pro: Deep expertise in TypeScript, including its advanced typing and module systems. Database Skills: Solid experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Distributed Systems: Familiarity with event-driven architecture using tools like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Bull/Redis. Data & Search: Hands-on experience with ClickHouse (or similar analytics DBs) and Elasticsearch. Architectural Mindset: A strong understanding of system design, clean architecture principles, and performance optimization. Ownership: The ability to work independently, take ownership of your work, and see projects through to completion. Communication: Comfortable working within a Russian-speaking team. Nice to Have Prior experience working in a remote-first, globally distributed team. Experience with performance monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). A genuine interest in the non-profit technology sector. A hypothesis-driven mindset and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Bonus points Curiosity and a hypothesis-driven mindset Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership Comfort working in fast-paced, data-rich environments Why work with us A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds. Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders. Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people. Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next. Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution. Compensation The compensation range for this role is: $4,700 - $5,500 gross per month. Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and alignment with the role's requirements. Benefits 31 days off. 100% paid telemedicine plan. Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace. English learning courses. Relevant professional education. Gym or swimming pool. Co-working. Remote working. Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Full Stack Engineer - AI Focus
description: About us We are the GenAI Hub, an AI company and IT service provider based in Bielefeld. For mid-sized companies we build custom software solutions that replace real processes: planning and scheduling systems, order processing, internal tools, plus AI components such as document extraction, agents and automations. Our clients come from manufacturing, construction, skilled trades, retail and insurance. Every project runs in its own environment on Azure, developed, deployed and maintained by us. We are a small team and are looking for a permanently employed developer. The job The bulk of the work is solid application development. Data models, roles and permissions, APIs, modern and genuinely usable interfaces, deployment and operations. AI topics are an important part of that, but not the whole job. You own projects from the requirements stage through to final acceptance. No working through tickets, but responsibility for complete solutions that clients use every day. Your tasks Development of custom web applications for client projects, backend with FastAPI, frontend with React Data modelling, authentication, role and permission concepts Deployment and operations on Azure, App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure SQL Connecting to existing client systems such as ERP, CRM or industry-specific software, often via file formats rather than modern APIs Integration of AI components, for example document extraction, LLM integration, automations Support of live systems, error analysis, further development Building reusable components so that not every project starts from scratch What you should bring A completed degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field At least 2 years of experience in software development Very good Python skills, ideally with FastAPI Experience with LLM APIs from Anthropic or OpenAI, including agents, tool use and handling unreliable outputs Solid knowledge of React, JavaScript, HTML and CSS Experience with relational databases and well thought-out data model design Experience with REST APIs, authentication and integrations Confident use of Git, experience with a cloud provider, in our case Azure You can take a project to completion independently and get up to speed in unfamiliar industries Very good English or German Nice to have Experience from an agency, a systems house or project work with several clients in parallel Experience with Docker and CI/CD, for example GitHub Actions You have not only built software, but also supported it in production What we offer Full responsibility from day one You have a say in technical decisions and shape how we build things going forward Current AI tools for development, paid for by us Short paths, no corporate structures, direct decisions Variety through changing industries and projects Salary: 60,000 to 90,000 TL
